name: Arturo Merzario
features: slight build, dark curly hair, stetson hat, wiry frame, quick smile
bio: Little Art, the cowboy-hatted Como driver Ferrari promoted from the Abarth ranks. Drove the works 512S at Le Mans in 1970 alongside Regazzoni, won the Targa Florio and the Spa 1000 km in 1972, and pulled Niki Lauda out of the fire at the Nurburgring in 1976.
